hero.title: Hair Architecture With Editorial Precision.
hero.copy: Noir Basel stands for reduced form, precise cutting and a calm, premium experience with clear user guidance.
hero.imageAlt: Interior of Noir Basel with a calm, architectural atmosphere

services.title: Structured offers with clear hierarchy.
services.copy: The services are not presented like a traditional price list, but as a precise offer architecture with a clear decision path.

essential.title: Cut & Finish
essential.copy: Precision haircut with consultation, shape refinement and a considered finish.

signature.title: Cut, Beard & Detail
signature.copy: For clients who want structure across silhouette, beard line and final texture.

colour.title: Tone & Correction
colour.copy: Controlled colour work with a focus on depth, restraint and longevity.

consultation.title: Style Direction
consultation.copy: Standalone consultation to map cut direction, maintenance and product system.

academy.title: Optional education layer for future brand expansion.
academy.copy: The layout intentionally keeps space for academy, methodology and content products. This allows Noir Basel to grow from service studio into a system brand without reinventing the visual order.
academy.imageAlt: Interior with a calm, premium salon atmosphere

about.title: A salon designed like a studio.
about.pointOne: Editorial restraint instead of overloaded lifestyle communication.
about.pointTwo: Clear user guidance with direct transitions to booking and contact.
about.pointThree: A systemic brand logic connecting services, education and trust.

booking.title: Ready to book your next appointment?
booking.copy: The final conversion block keeps the page focused: clear decision-making, a short contact path and no unnecessary friction.

footer.claim: Precision Hair Architecture for clients who value structure, restraint and a quietly luxurious experience.
